categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, owner names, property details, and legal encumbrances. The content is focused entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
